en.headline: John Lee leads officials in seasonal flu vaccine drive
en.dek: The chief executive and 22 senior officials received the jab as the government rolled out four measures to boost uptake for the 2026/27 season.
body: Chief Executive John Lee on Wednesday led a group of 22 bureau chiefs, permanent secretaries and department heads in receiving the seasonal influenza vaccine, urging the public to get inoculated early ahead of the flu season.

Lee said on social media that vaccination remains one of the most effective ways to prevent seasonal flu and its complications, reducing the risk of hospitalisation and death. The government this year introduced four improvements: diversifying vaccine suppliers, adding an electronic consent form on the eHealth system, raising the doctor procurement pilot quota to 300,000 doses and expanding eligible doctors, plus deeper community mobilisation.

The 2026/27 Seasonal Influenza Vaccination Programme has already begun. Lee called on residents to act promptly so that the community can build a stronger collective defence and better protect families.

zh.headline: 李家超率22名官員接種季節性流感疫苗
zh.dek: 行政長官與司局長、常秘及署長級官員一同打針，政府推出四大優化措施鼓勵市民盡早接種。
body: 今年度季節性流感疫苗接種計劃已經展開。行政長官李家超周三早上率領22名司局長、常秘及署長級官員響應呼籲，一同接種季節性流感疫苗，為應對流感季節做好準備。
李家超在社交網頁表示，接種疫苗是預防季節性流感及其併發症的最有效方法之一，可減低因流感而入院留醫和死亡的風險。為鼓勵和便利市民接種，政府今年推出四大優化措施，包括改進疫苗採購過程以採購非單一供應商的疫苗、新增醫健通電子同意書功能、增加「醫生疫苗採購先導計劃」額度至30萬劑並擴大合資格醫生範圍，以及深化動員社區力量。
他呼籲市民盡早接種，合力築起社區免疫屏障，更好保護自己和家人的健康。
